name: insufficient_history_short_circuit
description: Fewer than the MC minimum-history threshold of valid_dates. run_monte_carlo MUST short-circuit and return the documented degenerate-case probability (today: 100.0 — 'no data means we cannot reject beating the benchmark'). This pins the integer threshold AND the float-output sentinel as TWO DIFFERENT semantic roles that happen to share value 100.0.
derivation: len(valid_dates) = 10 < MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS (20). The function short-circuits at the first guard and returns the MC_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY_PROB sentinel (currently 100.0). This is a structural pin — the value is not derived from inputs; it is the documented degenerate-output.
